cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a small far-future planetarium rehearsal room on an orbital habitat — off duty she tries an event-host costume while turning a little eclipse disc in front of a lamp; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds her keepsake at chest height; a modern miniature-terrarium stall beneath a skylight — she places a tiny pale porous stone among damp moss inside a glass globe and tilts the globe to watch a faint veil of condensation clear; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a masquerade mask on a stick up to her eyes; her living room with a deep sofa — plays an acoustic guitar; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds a few lit incense sticks in both hands before her; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — standing with one foot up on a step; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a neon-lit bar counter with backlit bottles — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing
